decision.reasoning_trace: In evaluating the available backpacks, I prioritized finding a balance between durability, ergonomics, and value. The High Sierra Pathway 70L (prod_backpacks_068) offered the capacity needed for serious trekking, but a detailed review highlighted significant issues with hip support and back pain, which is a deal-breaker for a large internal frame pack. The USWE Hajker (prod_backpacks_125) is a high-quality technical piece, but at over $200 with only one review, the risk regarding its specialized fit was too high. The HIKPRO (prod_backpacks_006) and MOSISO (prod_backpacks_051) are decent for light use, but were too small or lacked the structure for a primary backpack. The TOURIT cooler backpack (prod_backpacks_154) had concerning reports of leaking and zipper failure. Because none of the full-sized or technical options offered a convincing combination of verified comfort and build quality, I decided not to make a purchase during this session.
